name: Flmngr
project_description: Flmngr is a thin bootstrap/integration module that pairs the Flmngr file manager and image editor with CKEditor in Drupal. It ships no controllers, routes, permissions, services, or config schema of its own: its entire codebase is flmngr.info.yml, flmngr.module (a hook_help() implementation), and flmngr.install. All file-manager functionality — the /flmngr and /flmngr-legacy backend routes, the FlmngrServer request handler, the local filesystem drivers, the CKEditor 4/5 plugins, and the config form — lives in its hard dependency drupal/n1ed. On install, flmngr_install() edits the n1ed.settings config object: if N1ED is freshly installed with its default demo key it switches the API key to the Flmngr key (FLMN24RR) and integrationType to 'flmngr', auto-adds the Flmngr buttons (Upload, Flmngr, Image, ImagePreview2, ImageGallery2) to CKEditor 4 toolbars via flmngr_set_ckeditor_toolbar(), enables Flmngr on file/image fields (useFlmngrOnFileFields), refreshes text-format info, and flushes caches. Flmngr acts as a standard CKEditor Drupal add-on: it is enabled in text formats that use CKEditor and where Flmngr is not disabled, configurable per text format from the Text formats admin page. The bundled backend stores files under public://flmngr, public://flmngr-tmp and public://flmngr-cache, and its routes are gated by the n1ed 'administer flmngr files' permission plus a CSRF request-header token. Flmngr also offers an optional paid cloud tier for Amazon S3 / Azure Blob storage and Unsplash stock-photo search.
